summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with four helper methods and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with two tests (binary 2D and empty class). Nothing was run, since the task forbade executing repository code; verification was by reading only. Not committed. Two notes: the cross-sample TP/D terms use an explicit (batch, batch, N) broadcast, and the distance matrix is also cast to the probabilities' dtype, a small addition beyond the spec. One existing line at dice.py:36 (in DiceLoss's docstring, not new code) is 128 columns and was left alone.
